hints: top is an index into data[], not a count. Starting it at -1 makes push 'increment then store' and pop 'read then decrement'.
isFull is about the last usable index: with CAP slots the highest valid index is CAP-1, so the stack is full when top has reached it.
push should be s->data[++(s->top)] = value; and pop should be return s->data[(s->top)--]; - note pre- vs post-increment.
